slider-events.label: Event Slider (Static)
slider-events.description: Horizontal scrollable slider of event cards. You supply the event markup — use this for hand-curated event lists.

slots.name: event-list
slots.description: Container of umd-element-events-date children, one per slide. Each child's date slots are read from TEXT CONTENT, not a datetime attribute.

slots.name: actions
slots.description: Section-level action. The slot applies layout only and no typography — put umd-element-call-to-action data-display="secondary" in it for the standard styled button. A bare <a> renders as unstyled body-weight text. See RULES.md §38.

slider-events.notes: DUPLICATE ENTRY: this component is also documented as `event-slider` in registry-cards.json, which carries the fuller slot detail. The two drifted apart and the cards copy previously gave wrong guidance for both the actions slot and the date slots. Prefer registry-cards.json; keep the two in sync until they are consolidated. Corrected 2026-09-22.

slider-events-feed.label: Event Slider (Feed)
slider-events-feed.description: Same horizontal slider as slider-events but auto-populated from the events API. Use when events should be pulled dynamically from a feed.

attrs.name: data-feed-type
attrs.description: Feed source. Omit for general events; use `academic` for the academic calendar.

attrs.name: data-filter-group-ids
attrs.description: Comma-separated category IDs to filter by.

slider-events-feed.notes: Requires a valid API token to fetch events. Without data-feed-type, fetches general events.
